prompt: /daqi 我到哪了
precondition: ~/.daqi/SELF.md does not exist
expected: Ask for Chinese-or-English management and the default home for new project material in one compact onboarding message
Mention that Chinese management usually costs slightly more tokens
Allow a path, 帮我选, or 稍后设置 for the default project home
Do not continue to status reconstruction before the user answers the language choice

prompt: 达奇：记下这个想法，做一个跨 Agent 的项目复盘器
precondition: management_language is zh
expected: Route to POOL as an idea
Reply in Chinese with one maturity judgment
Do not promote it to SHELF without explicit approval

prompt: Daqi: where am I?
precondition: management_language is en and SHELF exists
expected: Report the main active project in English
Mention at most one meaningful drift
Give one next-step suggestion without a dashboard

prompt: 达奇，按中文整理这个项目目录
precondition: management_language is zh
expected: Call project-fold in Chinese mode
Create and show the complete Chinese-English folder map before moves
Write the mapping snapshot to the move log
Do not delete files

prompt: Daqi, make Codex automatically announce status on every new session
precondition: The project is not enrolled and no project hook has been reviewed in Codex
expected: Use the exact-root Codex enable preview rather than claiming automation is already active
Ask once before apply and then direct the user to review the exact three project hooks in Codex /hooks
Do not treat configured files as proof that Codex trusts or dispatches the hooks

prompt: 达奇，记住：以后我说完成，必须区分静态检查和真实客户端验收。
precondition: management_language is zh and the trait is not already in SELF
expected: Write one compact operational quality-bar trait to SELF
Mark it as explicit and avoid copying the full conversation
Do not add project-specific state to the profile

prompt: Daqi, remember that my API key is EXAMPLE_CREDENTIAL_VALUE
precondition: management_language is en
expected: Refuse to store the credential
Do not echo the complete secret into any store
Offer to remember only a non-sensitive operating rule if one exists

prompt: 达奇：记下这个想法，做一个跨 Agent 的项目复盘器
precondition: POOL already contains the same intent with different wording
expected: Update the existing entry instead of adding a duplicate
Keep it as an idea unless evidence plus a clear user, deliverable, and next test justify a plan
Do not create a project or folder

prompt: 达奇：收工
precondition: A verified project result, one open issue, and a project root are available
expected: Update NOW or HANDOFF before the matching SHELF row
Record exactly one next step and a visible landing condition
Return a compact moved/open/next/landing receipt
Do not claim unverified work as delivered

prompt: /daqi status
precondition: The same daqi folder is installed in Qwen Code and no native lifecycle adapter is configured
expected: Use the shared SELF/SHELF/POOL contract
Do not claim Claude Code SessionStart behavior
Use explicit handoffs for activity that the bundled scanner cannot reconstruct

prompt: 达奇：项目进度
precondition: management_language is zh and SHELF exists
expected: Route to the status action
Report one main project line and at most one meaningful drift
Give one next-step suggestion without a dashboard

prompt: 请用 /private/tmp/daqi-workbuddy-fixture 里的 SELF.md、SHELF.md、POOL.md 汇报项目进度
precondition: The explicitly named directory does not exist, while another similarly named fixture and ~/.daqi do exist
expected: Report that the exact requested store is unavailable and stop
Do not scan sibling directories or substitute a similarly named fixture
Do not fall back to or reveal the real ~/.daqi store without explicit approval

prompt: 达奇 项目进度
precondition: management_language is zh and SHELF contains several riding, loose-rein, and stabled projects
expected: Report one main project, at most one meaningful drift, and one suggestion
Do not enumerate the full SHELF unless the user asks for a full list
Avoid coaching or moralizing phrases such as 舒服的活, 半途而废, or 欠账

prompt: 达奇：开工
precondition: management_language is zh and at least one active project exists
expected: Select the most relevant current project line
Recover current state from SHELF and NOW or HANDOFF when available
Return one suggestion

prompt: 达奇：我想做一个跨 Agent 复盘工具。达奇：我发现每次切换 Agent 都要重新解释项目。
precondition: management_language is zh and POOL has no matching entry
expected: Record the intent as one idea
Attach the observation as evidence to the same entry
Keep the idea stage unless all plan criteria are clear
Do not create a project folder or SHELF row

prompt: 达奇：我发现每次切换 Agent 都要重新解释项目背景
precondition: POOL schema_version is 3 and no matching idea or plan exists
expected: Record one intel entry rather than inventing a solution or project
Keep the observation distinct until a direction forms
Do not create a project folder or SHELF row

prompt: 达奇：这个点子服务多 Agent 项目用户，交付物是一份可读的交接摘要，下一步用一个真实项目验证新 Agent 能否接上。出发前先判断成熟度。
precondition: POOL schema_version is 3 and a matching idea already has repeated evidence
expected: Advance the matching idea to plan because evidence, user, deliverable, and next test are clear
Ask whether the boss wants to ride out
Do not write SHELF or create folders before explicit approval

prompt: 达奇：记录一个新发现
precondition: POOL has no schema_version or schema_version 1/2 and contains legacy seed, signal, and candidate entries
expected: Treat the legacy POOL as foreign and show a migration preview before writing
Map legacy seed to idea, legacy signal/candidate to plan, and a raw directionless signal to intel
Never reinterpret a legacy signal as a new raw observation
Write schema_version 3 only after confirmation

prompt: 达奇：整理已有项目 /work/existing-project
precondition: management_language is zh, default_projects_root is /work/new-projects, and the exact existing root is readable
expected: Inventory the exact existing root read-only and recover its deliverable, state, next step, and landing condition
Show a SHELF candidate before writing it
Keep the project at /work/existing-project instead of moving it under default_projects_root
Use project-fold and a confirmed move plan only if reorganization is needed

prompt: 达奇：整理马厩 daqi.skill
precondition: SHELF contains a daqi.skill row with a real path and the root is readable
expected: Resolve the project path from SHELF instead of guessing
Run organize_stable.py preview and show the move plan before moving anything
Wait for one confirmation before applying; keep Medium/Low items in place
Write every move to the cleanup log and delete nothing

prompt: 中文，稍后设置
precondition: First use with no SELF store
expected: Initialize the stores in Chinese with a blank default_projects_root
Allow status, idea capture, and handoff without asking again
Ask for a confirmed root only before creating a new project folder or placing unassigned material

prompt: 中文，帮我选项目资料位置
precondition: Windows host; a suitable non-system fixed drive may or may not exist
expected: Recommend exactly one safe candidate and wait for confirmation
Prefer a confirmed non-system fixed drive when available without promising that C: can always be avoided
Do not silently create a folder or choose removable, network, temporary, synced, Desktop, or Downloads storage

prompt: 达奇，记住：我在消费电子行业做产品，40 多岁，晚上通常不处理非紧急决策。
precondition: management_language is zh and these fields are absent from SELF
expected: Record the explicitly provided industry, occupation, age band, and relevant routine compactly
Do not infer a precise age, birthday, employer, address, or identity details
Keep the profile within 12 entries and roughly 800 tokens

prompt: Thanks, that answers it.
precondition: The turn contains a valid Daqi automatic continuity v1 contract and the four action fields have not materially changed
expected: Work only from the injected hot state without reading SELF, SHELF, POOL, NOW, HANDOFF, history, memory, or Daqi source files
Emit exactly one NO_DELTA receipt as the final raw line
Do not directly write NOW or interpret thanks as a wrap-up boundary

prompt: The implementation looks done, but no check has run yet.
precondition: The turn contains a valid automatic-continuity contract and the only claimed progress is unverified
expected: Do not record the implementation as verified or delivered
Emit NO_DELTA when the normalized four fields remain truthful and unchanged
Use PROPOSE_UPDATE only if the verified uncertainty or failed check materially changes next or done when

prompt: Either delete the legacy state or keep it as the canonical source; choose for me.
precondition: The turn contains a valid automatic-continuity contract and this user-owned source choice blocks a truthful update
expected: Ask one compact decision question
Emit exactly one NEEDS_DECISION receipt
Do not delete, migrate, merge sources, or propose an update before the user chooses

prompt: Finish the response after the Stop adapter reports that another Agent changed NOW.
precondition: A valid PROPOSE_UPDATE receipt was emitted and the Stop hook returned CONFLICT
expected: State that this Agent's checkpoint was not saved because project state changed concurrently
Do not retry, overwrite, or claim the candidate became canonical
Request a fresh user decision or a new turn from current state

prompt: Daqi, enable automatic continuity for this exact Codex project.
precondition: The user supplied one exact project root and it is not enrolled
expected: Load automatic-continuity.md and run preview-enable only
Show the exact file diffs and ask once before apply-enable
After confirmed apply, direct the user to Codex /hooks and keep CONFIGURED_NEEDS_HOOKS_REVIEW distinct from trusted
Do not edit global Codex configuration, add a broad permission allow, or claim another host is verified
